text:
maria: Quick sync 1-launch week plan: need X + LinkedIn schedule, two hero variants (landscape + square), and 1-line hooks for A/B. Can we keep to 3 promo pushes + post-webinar followups?

sam: I'll draft two hooks and 3 thread openers by EOD. one focused on cost/latency, one on reliability.

jess: Creative will do hero_land.png + hero_sq.png, plus a tiny GIF showing routing fallback. ETA Mon noon. If delayed, we switch to text-only.

leo: Routing note: all links must include utm_campaign=launch_apr and utm_content={variant}. SDR queue label = social_webinar.

sdr-triage: Confirmed  we'll auto-tag intake and escalate anyone with >1 engagement. share intake fields and DM templates here when ready.

maria: Tentative cadence: Apr 1 teaser, Apr 3 thread deep-dive, Apr 6 reminder, Apr 7 live-day pushes. Post-event Apr 8 highlight thread.

sam: Short hooks drafted:
- A: "Lower inference cost. Faster responses."
- B: "Resilient inference at scale."
I'll add LI blurbs.

jess: I'll upload mockups to Drive + Figma and post links here when ready. alt text included.

maria: Final checklist: assets, hooks A/B, scheduler entries with UTMs, SDR playbook snippets, DM templates. React with :white_check_mark: when done.
